subject: Changing size of column in facet

messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: Changing size of column in facet
parts:
Hi,

is there a way to change the width of a specific column in a facet?

ggplot(data,aes(x,y,colour=Section)) + geom_point(size=3) +
facet_grid(. ~ Section,scales="free_x")

But since each Section has a different number of points, the x-labels
get squeezed together since ggplot2 always uses the same width for
every Section-grid.

Thank you
Thomas
